sm_top.sm: Houthi missile and drone attacks on Riyadh airport resulted in 13 deaths and 17 injuries.
Israeli forces carried out operations and announced the closure of West Bank crossings following an attack in Hebron.
Saudi Arabia partially reopens Riyadh airport despite renewed Houthi threats.
Russian missiles and drones targeted Kyiv and other parts of Ukraine, causing casualties.
Houthis launched a series of missile and drone attacks targeting Saudi airports, oil facilities, and cities, with interceptions reported over Mecca and Medina.
Ukraine targeted Russia with a large-scale drone attack, successfully striking an oil terminal in St. Petersburg.
The UN Security Council demanded clarification regarding drone attacks in Abyei.
Romania blamed Russia for a drone strike that sank a cargo ship in the Black Sea, killing 1 and leaving 3 missing.
An IRGC official warned that Iran would target undersea internet cables in the Strait of Hormuz if its infrastructure is attacked.
The death toll from a church attack in Jordan rose to nine.
A Houthi siege and shelling in Taiz caused severe shortages and casualties, pushing hospitals toward collapse.
Debris from intercepted missiles injured two people in Saudi Arabia.
An explosion rocked Yemen's Aden as a suspected Houthi missile landed near a military headquarters.
An oil tanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz.
An oil spill from a tanker forced the closure of beaches in Umm Al Quwain.
UK and French troops conducted joint military exercises simulating attacks on NATO.
Iranian forces say they shot down a U.S. drone over Bandar Abbas.
US intelligence indicates Iran is in advanced stages of planning attacks against US targets in the region.
A drone attack damaged facilities in Togliatti, which Ukrainian sources identify as a petrochemical plant.
Saudi-led coalition airstrikes in Yemen resulted in more than 10 deaths.
Ukrainian drone attacks targeted Moscow airports and missile-parts plants, disrupting flights and prompting air defense interceptions.
Heavy airstrikes hit Yemen and Sanaa, resulting in civilian casualties.
The death toll in a village raid by gunmen in Nigeria rose to 48, with fleeing residents drowning in a boat mishap.
Russia attacked Ukraine with over 100 drones and missiles, with hits recorded at multiple locations.
The Malian military updated the death toll from a recent attack to 54.
A Russian drone attack damaged a residential house in Kyiv and injured two people.
The Israeli military conducted a massive operation in the West Bank days before the election.
A drone attack injured five people and damaged an industrial facility in Russia's Perm region.
A Ukrainian drone attack on Russia's Omsk Region injured three people, according to the governor.
Russian attacks in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast killed 3 people.
An investigation revealed that the RSF systematically targeted the healthcare system in El Fasher.
The UN reports that drone strikes have killed at least 306 people in Sudan.
Ansarallah launched missile and drone strikes hitting a camp in Shabwa, resulting in dozens of fatalities among security personnel.
The injury toll from a Russian attack on Vinnytsia rose to seven as search and rescue operations concluded.
A Russian attack on the Chernihiv region killed one civilian and wounded several others.
A terrorist attack on a church in Jordan left nine people dead and 40 injured.
Russian MoD claimed air defense forces intercepted and destroyed hundreds of Ukrainian drones overnight across multiple regions.
Reports state that over 570 merchant vessels have been attacked and 40 seafarers killed in the Black Sea this year.
A Houthi missile strike hits a gathering of Saudi-led troops, leaving dozens dead.
Russian air defenses intercepted hundreds of Ukrainian drones over various regions.
